checks.quote: Authenticating with the Discord API can be done in one of three ways: Using a bot token found on the Bot page within your app’s settings. For more information on bots see bots vs user accounts . Using an OAuth2 bearer token gained through the OAuth2 API . Using basic authentication with credentials as the client ID and client secret found on the OAuth2 page of your app’s settings in the format client_id:client_secret as a Base64 encoded string.
The Discord API is a REST API that allows you to interact with Discord data from your own applications. It’s the primary way to interact with Discord from your own code.
